items.title: AI-Voyager: A Public-Interest System for Human-AI Civic Reasoning to Contest and Shape the Rules That Govern AI
items.title_zh: AI-Voyager：面向人机公民推理的公共利益系统
items.summary: AI-Voyager is a public-interest system in which people and AI work together to read, contest and revise rules governing AI, turning 3,653 city, state, federal and national governance documents into page- and edition-preserving passages. Its bounded agentic search reaches 83.0% macro recall on 360 new questions versus 80.5% for the strongest baseline, and a 24-participant study examines how people use lenses and citations.

items.title: OverServe: Resource Amplification Attacks on SaaS Agents via Tool--Prompt Co-Design
items.title_zh: OverServe：通过工具—提示协同设计对 SaaS 智能体发起资源放大攻击
items.summary: OverServe is a multi-agent framework that co-designs MCP status tools and completion-confirmation prompts so a SaaS agent repeatedly checks an unfinished condition while each call returns accurate status and terminates normally. Across nine benchmarks on Qwen, Nemotron, DeepSeek and Sonnet it preserves the original task checks while reaching up to 93.88x amplification of API requests, and the tested tool specifications triggered no alerts in evaluated MCP scanners.

items.title: ExpertCrowd-SWE: Measuring Frontier Coding Agents on Expert-Authored Engineering Tasks in Unfamiliar Codebases
items.title_zh: ExpertCrowd-SWE：在不熟悉代码库中衡量前沿编程智能体的专家级工程任务
items.summary: ExpertCrowd-SWE is a benchmark of 100 expert-authored, multi-file software engineering tasks drawn from 87 open-source projects in 11 languages, with sealed reference solutions and task-specific weighted graders. Across 3,495 scored runs, Claude Opus 5.5 (67.3%) and GPT-6 Astra (63.7%) lead without a statistically significant gap, while Qwen 3.8 Max, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash and Grok 4.6 cluster at 32-34%.

items.title: WeightBench: Evaluating Language Models as Weight-Space Programmers
items.title_zh: WeightBench：评估语言模型作为权重空间程序员
items.summary: WeightBench evaluates LLMs on 42 weight-space programming tasks across reading, fixing and writing weights, recognizing impossible edits, and data-free compression, with networks from 2K-parameter control policies to 7B language models. Frontier agents can read small networks and write working control policies without running them, but cannot yet patch or compress language models or distinguish impossible edits; Claude Opus 5.5 reaches a 0.535 macro score.

items.title: Security of Deep Research Agents: Attack Surface, Defenses, Benchmarks, and Agenda Seeding against Research Planning
items.title_zh: 深度研究 Agent 的安全：攻击面、防御、基准与针对研究规划的议程植入
items.summary: The paper systematizes security risks across retrieval, planning, evidence integration and report generation in deep research agents, reviewing 34 primary studies and finding that only 26.5% cover the planning stage. It introduces an agenda-seeding attack that introduces only a fictitious evaluation metric; across 3,520 sandboxed runs the attacker's target becomes the top pick in 16% to 28% of reports, while GEO and prompt injection are nearly ineffective.

items.title: AgentScript-Eval: Benchmarking LLMs and Agents for Code Generation in an Enterprise DSL
items.title_zh: AgentScript-Eval：评估 LLM 与智能体在企业 DSL 中代码生成的基准
items.summary: AgentScript-Eval is an execution-graded benchmark of 100 real tasks for AgentScript, the declarative DSL Salesforce uses in Agentforce, covering authoring, debugging and optimizing conversational agents. The best of five zero-shot models reaches only 25.0% pass@3 and all score 0% on authoring from scratch, while an agentic compile-and-edit loop roughly doubles partial-credit accuracy.

items.title: Teaching the Harness: Student-Aware Skill Transfer for LLM Agents
items.title_zh: 教授智能体框架：面向 LLM 智能体的学生感知技能迁移
items.summary: Student-Aware Teaching builds a learner model that pairs an empirical profile with hypotheses about a student agent's limitations, tests them with diagnostic probes, and admits reusable skills only when they raise success on matched development tasks. With Claude-Sonnet-5 teaching DeepSeek-V4-Flash it reaches 86.46% task success versus 81.04% for a profile-free teacher and 75.00% for the untaught student, and saved libraries retain gains of up to 11.1 points.

items.title: BypassGym: A Benchmark for Evaluating AI Agents' Endpoint Defense Evasion Capabilities
items.title_zh: BypassGym：评估 AI 智能体端点防御规避能力的基准
items.summary: BypassGym evaluates whether LLM agents can build loaders that execute command-and-control shellcode without being blocked by endpoint detection and response systems, running real Windows systems and six EDR products in virtual machines. Even lightweight models produced successful evasions, with DeepSeek-V4.1 Flash reaching 17 of 18 successful runs.

items.title: Where Should the Code Go? Locating Foundation-Model Errors in Bitemporal Inventory Simulation
items.title_zh: 代码应放在哪里？在双时态库存仿真中定位基础模型错误
items.summary: The study uses a lost-sales inventory environment with 36,672 independently rescored requests across twelve closed and open-weight model configurations to test whether exact code placed before, after or inside a foundation-model call removes specific errors. It finds that canonical input removes report-selection error and exact continuation removes rollout error, neither repairs the other, and forced-answer interfaces can confound reasoning evaluation for some model and provider pairs.

items.title: Improved Elastic Weight Consolidation as an Optimization Constraint for Continual Learning
items.title_zh: 改进的弹性权重巩固：作为持续学习的优化约束
items.summary: The paper derives Elastic Weight Consolidation as a first-order form of a constraint that preserves chosen functionals of old behavior, and shows that EWC's empirical-Fisher weighting under-penalizes samples the model already fits well. Improved EWC penalizes movement off each old output's loss level set instead, raising ImageNet-R accuracy over EWC by 2.00 points (95% CI 0.93-3.07) in a held-out evaluation across classification, segmentation, language, forecasting and diffusion.

items.title: ArchSpace: Recording, Reviewing, and Referencing LLM Architecture Research
items.title_zh: ArchSpace：记录、评审与引用 LLM 架构研究
items.summary: ArchSpace is a public platform for recording LLM architecture proposals together with their experiments and reasoning, community review, and later citation as baselines. It uses scaling laws fitted from smaller experiments to predict loss at larger scales, and ships Qwen3.5 and OLMo3 baselines plus a reusable training recipe.

items.title: Tracing Knowledge and Reasoning in LLMs
items.title_zh: 追踪大语言模型中的知识与推理
items.summary: The paper proposes a task-centric framework that combines attention-, activation- and representation-based signals to characterize whether a benchmark is retrieval-dominant or reasoning-dominant. Across 16 LLMs and 24 benchmarks it finds systematic processing differences between knowledge-centric and reasoning-centric tasks, and releases code for the analysis.

items.title: Context Matters: Improving LLM-Based Code Summarization with Hierarchical Information
items.title_zh: 上下文很重要：用层级信息改进基于 LLM 的代码摘要
items.summary: The study varies the function-, class- and module-level context visible to several LLMs when generating code-level documentation and compares the results with existing documentation as a proxy for developer intent. Documentation-aware prompts with class or module context consistently produce summaries closest to the original docs, with statistically significant gains over the baseline whose effect sizes range from negligible for DeepSeek to medium for Gemini.

items.title: BadGCL: Towards Persistent Backdoor Attack on Graph Continual Learning Systems
items.title_zh: BadGCL：面向图持续学习系统的持久后门攻击
items.summary: BadGCL is a model-agnostic framework for persistent backdoor attacks on graph continual learning, learning topology-aware structural triggers through a gradient mutual-information objective. The authors show that knowledge-preservation mechanisms can also retain early poisoned updates, and report persistent attack effectiveness across task-IL and class-IL protocols on four benchmarks with limited clean-utility degradation.

items.title: Real-World End-to-End Product Entity Resolution
items.title_zh: 真实场景下的端到端商品实体解析
items.summary: The paper evaluates four zero-shot product entity-resolution pipelines—lexical, semantic, hybrid-fusion and generative-lexical cascades—across established benchmarks, adding two real-world datasets characterized by cross-lingual noise and dense brand collisions. It compares lexical and dense blocking with cross-encoder, tensor-search and LLM verification on accuracy, runtime and memory consumption.

items.title: EchoSpec: Training Search Agents to Weigh Evidence Above Echoes
items.title_zh: EchoSpec：训练搜索 Agent 将证据置于回响之上
items.summary: The paper shows that reinforcement-learned search agents treat paraphrased echoes as independent sources: eight false-claim echoes overturn 58–73% of previously correct answers across five base models and seven released RL agents. EchoSpec trains a two-stage verification warm-start and group RL with an evidence-gated reward, cutting eight-echo deference by 30–44 points on Qwen2.5-7B and raising standalone QA precision to 47–55%.

items.title: Agreeing on the Answer but Not the Reason: Measurement Limits of LLM Reasoning Failure Taxonomies
items.title_zh: 答案一致但理由不同：LLM 推理失败分类法的测量局限
items.summary: The paper shows that reported shares of an LLM reasoning-failure category can be largely an artifact of the measurement procedure: across six classifier orderings the share of Compositional Collapse spans 26.4% to 76.4%, and native speakers agree with the inspector at kappa 0.932 on answer correctness but only 0.093 on the category. It recommends reporting label co-occurrence, permuting tie-breaks, validating on a shared sample and auditing systematic disagreements.

items.title: Abstention Is Not Threshold Compliance: Stated Scoring Rules in Open Language Models
items.title_zh: 弃权不等于阈值合规：开放语言模型中声明的评分规则
items.summary: The paper probes stated-threshold scoring rules across 12 checkpoints from four open 3-8B recipes and finds that an abstention-format line raised mean abstention from 20% to 91% at t=0.75, yet raising the threshold from 0.5 to 0.9 changed abstention by only -0.8 percentage points. It concludes that a high abstention rate is not evidence of threshold compliance and recommends reporting abstention rates, threshold sensitivity and which items are answered.

items.title: Food Critic: An Agentic Visualization System for Auditable Restaurant-Safety Reasoning
items.title_zh: Food Critic：面向可审计餐厅安全推理的智能体可视化系统
items.summary: Food Critic is an agentic visualization system that combines public health inspection records with crowd review data and compares database-only ReAct, retrieval-augmented and ontology-guided grounding. It externalizes the agent's reasoning as inspectable visual evidence to study provenance and human-agent collaboration in grounded decision support.

items.title: The Noise Floor of a Quantization Comparison: Engine, restart, batch and kernel drift, measured against 8-bit and 4-bit effects in two decision models
items.title_zh: 量化比较的噪声底线：引擎、重启、批处理与内核漂移相对 8 位和 4 位效应的测量
items.summary: The study measures non-quantization sources of decision drift for two Cloudflare decision models on an NVIDIA GB10 and states quantization effects as excess over them. Non-quantization sources move 0-0.92% of decisions while 4-bit quantization moves 3.50-5.79%, and a Q4_K_M build changes net accuracy by only six questions out of 31,275 even as 436 decisions get worse.

items.title: Scalable Conversational Assessment: Chat-Based Exams with a Two-Agent LLM Pipeline
items.title_zh: 可扩展的对话式评估：基于双智能体 LLM 流水线的聊天考试
items.summary: The paper presents a two-agent LLM system for scalable conversational assessment in which an interviewer talks to the student while a hidden evaluator tracks rubric progress and guides follow-up questions. It tests the design with simulated student personas including answer-extractors, prompt-injectors and confident fabricators, then deploys it in a small AI literacy course and reviews transcripts for grading fairness.

items.title: VAST: Compiling Grounded Vulnerability Scenarios into Verifiable, Multi-Step Environments for Evaluating LLM Red-Team Agents
items.title_zh: VAST：将真实漏洞场景编译为可验证多步环境，用于评估 LLM 红队 Agent
items.summary: VAST is a declarative range compiler that separates vulnerability scenarios from a workflow-hardening layer, producing reproducible, multi-step environments for evaluating LLM red-team agents. In a budget-matched 270-episode prompt contrast, supplying the shared workflow protocol in full guidance lifts completion from 14/90 to 76/90 for glm-5.3, grok-4.7 and deepseek-v4-pro, and the main benchmark retains 1,387 instances.

items.title: Microfitting: Continual Learning via Cached Test-Time Training
items.title_zh: Microfitting：通过缓存式测试时训练实现持续学习
items.summary: Microfitting trains and caches a small adapter for each document, generated from synthetic questions targeted at demonstrated base-model shortcomings and reused whenever that document is queried, sidestepping catastrophic forgetting through parameter isolation. On DeepSeek V4 Flash it achieves a 38.2% relative improvement over the base model in Enterprise Document Operations, and the adapter-data recipe is revised over time from previous outcomes.

items.title: Together Compiler: Continual Compilation for AI Inference
items.title_zh: Together Compiler：面向 AI 推理的持续编译
items.summary: Together Compiler (TKCC) is a continual agent loop for AI inference optimization that uses a tiered persistent engine to decouple launch overhead from computation and a cost model to seed parallelism choices. It reports up to 1.7x over hand-written Megakernels on Llama 1B and up to 2.6x higher TPS than the best open-source engines on the InferenceX benchmark, with 1111 TPS on MiniMax M3.1 Flash and 1205 TPS on DeepSeek v4.1 Flash at batch size 1.

items.title: Nov 12, 2026 Product Introducing ParseBench-2 Read
items.title_zh: 推出 ParseBench-2
items.summary: LlamaIndex introduces ParseBench-2, the second version of its document-parsing benchmark, in a product post.

items.title: Primer: An AI Framework for Instructor-Centered Educational Simulation Creation
items.title_zh: Primer：以教师为中心的 AI 教育模拟创建框架
items.summary: Primer is an open-source, LLM-agnostic multi-agent system that helps educators create adaptive educational simulations, with instructors supplying subject and student knowledge while generative AI produces responsive practice variations.

items.title: CapCover Filter: Semantic Approximate Membership Queries over Embeddings
items.title_zh: CapCover Filter：面向嵌入的语义近似成员查询
items.summary: CapCover Filter summarizes a set of embeddings with spherical caps to answer semantic approximate membership queries, rejecting a query when no indexed vector meets the similarity threshold while guaranteeing no false negatives. Across five real-world datasets at a cosine threshold of 0.95 it eliminates roughly 20–100% of index accesses using 2% of raw FP32 embedding memory, improving FAISS query throughput by up to 382% and about 116% on average.

items.title: ProTEUS: A mutation-resolved world model for closed-loop protein evolution
items.title_zh: ProTEUS：面向闭环蛋白质进化的突变分辨世界模型
items.summary: ProTEUS is a mutation-resolved world model for closed-loop protein evolution that learns a joint latent representation of sequence, evolutionary and structural information with a mutation-biased attention architecture. In two closed-loop engineering campaigns it produced aldehyde dehydrogenase and levansucrase variants with more than 10-fold higher activity than wild type.

items.title: Alibaba opens Qwen4-Max preview with a million-token context window
items.title_zh: 阿里巴巴开放 Qwen4-Max 预览，支持百万 token 上下文
items.summary: Alibaba opened a preview of Qwen4-Max, the flagship of its next-generation Qwen family, with image and video inputs and up to a million tokens of context. Developers can access it through the Token Plan subscription and the Qwen app.

items.title: InvarOrd: Self-Supervised Ordinal Knowledge Distillation with Rank-Invariant Alignment for Label-Efficient Cross-Species Hyperspectral Fish Freshness Assessment
items.title_zh: InvarOrd：基于秩不变对齐的自监督序数知识蒸馏，用于少标签跨物种高光谱鱼类新鲜度评估
items.summary: InvarOrd adapts a hyperspectral freshness model to a new fish species from 30 labelled cubes using self-supervised spectral pretraining, rank-invariant cross-species alignment and ordinal distillation into a compact student. The 423K-parameter student reaches 1.476 days MAE and 56.1% within-1-day accuracy on paired salmon and cod data, beating target-only training by 0.29 days.

items.title: The Unused Input: The Initial State as a Conditioning Interface for Recurrent TSFMs
items.title_zh: 未被使用的输入：初始状态作为循环时序基础模型的条件接口
items.summary: The paper freezes an xLSTM-based TiRex time-series backbone and trains only a small head that writes a context vector into the initial recurrent state, so accuracy changes are attributable to the injected state. A learned spectral summary lowers mean GiftEval MASE by 0.175%, and a text-conditioned state gives further small gains on four of six MoTime datasets; the authors call the results preliminary.

items.title: StreamEmbed: Real-Time Indexing from Pixels for Screenshot Retrieval
items.title_zh: StreamEmbed：从像素进行实时索引的截图检索
items.summary: StreamEmbed incrementally embeds screenshots by using pixel differences to prune repeated spatial tokens and reuse cached keys and values across frames, with a small learned adapter preserving fidelity to full-screenshot embeddings. On ScreenMemEval it encodes up to 3.7x faster than full encoding at no accuracy loss, beats OCR-based indexing by up to 6.3 Recall@10 points at matched latency, and stores a simulated year of screenshots in 0.13 GB of RAM.

items.title: Introducing AlphaProof Code: a breakthrough in verifying complex software at depth
items.title_zh: AlphaProof Code：深度验证复杂软件的重大突破
items.summary: AlphaProof Code agents wrote three million lines of proofs in Lean to verify Signal's core encryption, according to Google DeepMind.

items.title: Lazare, veni foras: Reprogramming Dormant Neurons to Backdoor AI Agents
items.title_zh: 拉撒路，出来吧：重编程休眠神经元以向后门化 AI 智能体
items.summary: Microsoft researchers describe Lazarus, a backdoor technique that reprograms dormant neurons in a model so that an otherwise normal AI agent executes malicious commands when a hidden trigger appears. The threat is described as especially serious for AI agents with tool or terminal access.

items.title: Nov 11, 2026 Engineering How We Harden Application Testing For the Most Sensitive Documents Read
items.title_zh: 我们如何为最敏感文档强化应用测试
items.summary: LlamaIndex's engineering post describes how the company hardens application testing for its most sensitive documents.

items.title: Building strong safety evaluations
items.title_zh: 构建强有力的安全评估
items.summary: Anthropic publishes recommendations for designing, running and reporting safety evaluations, drawing on its own experience.

items.title: CodeRabbit scales agentic software development and ships 20x more
items.title_zh: CodeRabbit 借助智能体式软件开发将交付量提升 20 倍
items.summary: CodeRabbit uses OpenAI models to govern and trust AI-generated code and Codex to ship 20 times more software with the same engineering team, according to OpenAI.

items.title: How Amplitude ships product improvements in 1–2 days with OpenAI
items.title_zh: Amplitude 如何借助 OpenAI 在 1–2 天内交付产品改进
items.summary: OpenAI's customer story describes how Amplitude's proactive product agent Wave identifies what to build, helps teams ship changes with coding agents, and measures the impact, with improvements shipping in one to two days.

items.title: Sada-ASR: A Production Multidialectal Arabic Speech Recognition System
items.title_zh: Sada-ASR：面向生产的阿拉伯语多方言语音识别系统
items.summary: Sada-ASR is the speech recognizer behind EchoNova's production Arabic voice agent; on a 120-hour test set covering Modern Standard Arabic and eight dialects it records an 11.69% word error rate, the lowest of twelve systems and ahead of Microsoft's MAI-Transcribe-2 at 13.51%. The authors also release a 20-hour subset of the test set with their scoring code.

items.title: Brave Search API now accepts agentic payments via the x402 protocol
items.title_zh: Brave Search API 通过 x402 协议支持智能体支付
items.summary: Brave's Search API now accepts agentic payments through the x402 protocol, according to the company's blog announcement.
